content.comment_body: Hello, I'm unable to install the [product_name] software on my laptop. This is the link I downloaded: [url]. My laptop runs Windows 10 Pro 64-bit. I've attached an error image. Assistance through messaging apps would be appreciated.
Hello, Do you already have an earlier version of [product_name] installed? (The file you downloaded is only an update.)

Yes, I had installed the demo version. Let me know if I did the installation incorrectly. Can you advise which one I should install first? Is there a standard procedure document you can share? Can you provide the link for downloading an older version?
Upgrading works only if you have a licensed full version. Demo versions cannot be upgraded, otherwise there would be no need to buy the full version.

You'll need the full licensed [product_name] version installed on your PC before applying the update. Note, the free download available online is only a demo version and can't be updated. To continue, you should uninstall the demo version and purchase the full version. Be sure to check which version you buy (e.g., [version_no]); updates are available for free online. The latest release is [version_no].1. Hope this clarifies the steps.

Thank you everyone. My issue was resolved after following these steps: 1) Run the initial setup file, 2) Open [product_name] V7 (required), 3) Exit the software, 4) Run the upgrade/update setup file for V8.1 to complete the installation.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experienced difficulties installing [product_name] due to confusion between demo, full, and update versions. The main challenge was unclear instructions regarding version compatibility, resulting in installation errors. The problem was eventually resolved by following specific procedural steps, emphasizing the need for improved installation guidance and onboarding support.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple installation process with clear guidance on which software versions and steps are required to successfully set up [product_name].
